title: Live: hybrid retrieval (RRF keyword + vector fusion)
summary: New tests/integration/test_hybrid_search.py — real reciprocal-rank-fusion ordering over live Db2 rows (PIPE-1).
description: PIPE-1's hybrid keyword+vector RRF search has no live-Db2 test. Add tests/integration/test_hybrid_search.py: seed rows in one scope with realistic overlapping/distinguishing text content and deliberately-placed embeddings (reuse make_unit_vec-style deterministic vectors from conftest.py so vector rank is predictable) such that keyword-only ranking and vector-only ranking would disagree on ordering for at least one pair of rows; run the hybrid search path against the live store and assert the fused ordering matches the RRF formula (k=60, per DECISIONS.md's 'RRF constant: k = 60' entry) computed independently in the test rather than just asserting 'some result came back'. Confirm real Db2 keyword scoring behavior matches what DECISIONS.md's 'Db2 Text Search Extender — confirmed non-dependency' entry says is actually used (not the Text Search Extender). Define local fixtures inside this file only.

comments.text: Done. Created tests/integration/test_hybrid_search.py — 5 tests: pure vector baseline (row B first), hybrid reorders row A higher, RRF formula verified independently in test (k=60), empty query_text degenerates to vector-only, no Text Search Extender confirmed by successful execution on standard Db2.
